cfg.kineticcore.network.var_int.desc:

cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.restart: Click Save to write startup feature settings. Restart the game or server for changes to take effect.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.m: Keeps server flight state stable and supports dimension/respawn restoration, no-clip movement checks, and high-speed movement handling.
Provides client flight inertia control, smooth no-clip movement, dynamic flight speed, and mode-switch anti-jitter behavior.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.p: Allows players to actively enter or leave the crawling pose.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.w: Controls first join, no-bed respawn fallback, shared spawn coordinates, and spawn-chunk preparation.
Provides recycle-bin protection for deleted worlds and related screen navigation behavior.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.e: Fixes bee pathfinding and spawn offsets and adjusts gravity, turtle-egg interaction, hitbox size, and eye height.
Adjusts client-side bee rendering orientation and display size.
Lets ordinary mobs made persistent by picking up items naturally despawn again while returning picked-up equipment.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.v: Stops server recipe-book save, load, sync, and award processing and handles related advancement data.
Stops client recipe-book collection setup and recipe-book button display.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.a: Allows KineticCore to apply configurable minimum and maximum values to supported attributes.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.m: Records the duration of each server tick for TPS/MSPT monitoring and related commands. Disabling this switch makes those samples unavailable.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.p: Prevents damage indicator particles from spawning to reduce extra combat-scene overhead.
Reclaims abandoned render-target textures and framebuffers to reduce long-session VRAM leak risk.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.c: Lets item-copy tools accurately read the slot under the pointer in vanilla and modded containers.
Applies KineticCore default options when the client options file is first created or damaged, including custom default keys.
Provides narrator disabling, multiplayer-list cleanup, notification interception, and world-loading confirmation improvements.
Provides compact effect layout, hover-to-front behavior, compatibility-area avoidance, and night-vision anti-flicker handling.
cfg.kineticcore.startup_features.entry.n: Extends configured protocol handling limits for NBT, strings, chunk data, payloads, VarInts, and related traffic.
